sections.name: Case Studies
sections.description: Multi-perspective investigations of a single business problem, shown through the editorial lens of five major publications.
sections.description_zh: 以五大出版機構的編輯視角，透視單一商業難題的多角度案例研究。

items.title: VIBEITDA: Why AI-Native Companies Can Grow Without Growing Headcount
items.title_zh: VIBEITDA：為何 AI 原生公司能在不增加人手下成長
items.summary: When AI lets companies increase output faster than payroll, the old trade-off between venture-style growth and private-equity-style efficiency collapses. Five publications examine the consequences from five angles.
items.summary_zh: 當 AI 讓企業的產出增長快於薪酬增長，傳統「增長 vs 效率」的二選一便告失效。五種出版角度解析這場變革。
cover_zh_text: 為何 AI 原生公司能在不增加人手下成長

items.title: Scrum in the Age of AI Agents: When Execution Becomes Abundant
items.title_zh: AI 代理時代的 Scrum：當執行變得充裕
items.summary: AI agents are making software execution abundant, and the bottleneck moves from producing change to verifying it. Five publications examine what that shift does to Scrum, to engineering productivity, and to the economics of software delivery.
items.summary_zh: AI 代理令軟件執行變得充裕，瓶頸也由「生產變更」轉移到「驗證變更」。五種出版角度剖析這場轉變對 Scrum、工程生產力與軟件交付經濟學的衝擊。

items.title: When Code Becomes Abundant: Rethinking Engineering Performance in the Age of AI
items.title_zh: 當代碼變得充裕：重新思考 AI 時代的工程績效
items.summary: AI coding tools are making engineering activity cheap to produce, hollowing out the signals managers have always used to judge performance. Five publications examine how engineering performance management must move upstream — from counting output to measuring judgment, uncertainty reduction, and difficulty retired.
items.summary_zh: AI 編程工具令工程活動變得廉價，掏空了管理者賴以判斷績效的訊號。五種出版角度剖析工程績效管理如何向上游轉移——由點算產出，轉向量度判斷力、降低不確定性與難度退役。
